conviction_note: No unpriced company-level number found; the findings are small and mostly inside what QuantumScape already guided (FY adj. EBITDA loss $250-275M, H2 Eagle output doubling, PowerCo milestone restructure), summing to +0.7 on a crowded short (22% float) with calls bid (skew -21.6) at a 52-week low. The scaled number is -0.42 (p_up 48 x abs 10.5) because this name has sold 4 of 7 prints, two of the last three by about 12%, including a Q2 EPS beat. That gap in sign is the reaction-history veto against a positioning lean, not an inconsistency.
bar: Q3 2026 EPS consensus -$0.18 (Zacks, unchanged 60 days, ESP 0.00%: https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/tsla-qs-lad-auto-stocks-122800203.html, 2026-10-20) against -$0.17 'EPS next Q' (Finviz, https://finviz.com/quote.ashx?t=QS, read 2026-10-21). EBITDA loss guide of $250-275M (reiterated in Q2; H1 actual $127.4M, so H2 implies $122.6-147.6M, about $61-74M a quarter), plus FY capex of $27-37M (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1811414/000119312526312423/qs-ex99_1.htm). findings.finding: The Q3 2026 quarter is the first full quarter under the PowerCo amendment signed 2026-07-16. It replaced SOW No.1's cost-reimbursement structure with milestone payments capped at $75.4M over two years, including amounts already paid. So reported customer billings (Q1 $11.0M, Q2 $10.8M, a mix of development activity and partner payments) can step down in Q3, and nobody publishes a billings consensus. Management called the amendment cash-neutral because project expenses fall too.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This is the partner and milestone line the stock trades on. Q2 2026 (2026-07-22) fell -12.86% close to close despite an EPS beat, when the same amendment cut potential PowerCo payments from about $131M to $75M (https://parameter.io/quantumscape-qs-stock-tumbles-6-despite-earnings-beat-as-volkswagen-deal-shrinks/).
findings.why_not_priced: The cap itself was priced in July (-12.9%). What is not visible yet is how lumpy the quarterly billings look under milestones. If the market had priced a billings drop, previews would carry a Q3 billings number. The Zacks preview carries only H1 billings of $21.8M and no Q3 figure.
findings.independence: Q2 call summary: management expects the amendment to be cash-neutral and the $130M royalty prepayment is unchanged (https://finance.yahoo.com/m/27afc2ea-1ad8-35ee-8952-e2aae63de480/quantumscape-corporation-q2.html). That softens the finding. The billings history comes from a different document, the Q1 and Q2 letters.

findings.finding: Adjusted EBITDA loss ran $63.2M in Q1 and $64.2M in Q2, both 'in line with expectations'. The reiterated FY guide of $250-275M leaves $122.6-147.6M for H2, about $61-74M a quarter. A Q3 near $64M sits at the low end and leaves room to narrow the FY guide toward $250M, while capex was already cut from $40-60M to $27-37M.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Cost discipline has not moved this stock. The Q2 capex cut and reiterated EBITDA guide came alongside -12.86%, and Q1's reiteration came alongside +1.37% close to close after a +32% open faded (Yahoo daily bars 2026-04-22/23).
findings.why_not_priced: It is mostly priced, because it lands inside the guided range. A narrowed FY guide toward the low end would be a small new fact. If it were already expected, the previews would quote a narrowed number, and none does.
findings.independence: Q1 2026 letter, Q1 adj. EBITDA loss $63.2M (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1811414/000119312526170507/qs-ex99_1.htm). It is a different document from the same company.

findings.finding: Liquidity has run down from $970.8M (YE2025) to $904.7M (Q1) to $859.0M (Q2), about $45-65M a quarter. Q3 should land around $800M, and the Q2 cash flow shows no 2026 ATM issuance, only $3.0M from option and ESPP exercises. With the stock at $4.01, a newly announced equity program would be the financing risk. Asked what the money buys, the answer is the H2 Eagle Line output doubling and sampling, and no covenant or going-concern language appears.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No financing event has coincided with a print in the 7-event baseline. The 2025 ATM was tiny (206k shares, H1 2025, per the Q2 2026 10-Q).
findings.why_not_priced: No document points to a raise. The market cap (about $2.5B) still sits well above liquidity (about $0.8B), and the September 52-week-low articles cite 'ongoing spending needs' generally. A priced raise would show as the stock trading near cash or as put skew, and the skew is the opposite.
findings.independence: Liquidity series from the Q4 2025 and Q1 2026 letters (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1811414/000119312526046623/qs-ex99_1.htm). The GuruFocus 2026-09-29 article attributes the slide to spending needs without new news (https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/quantumscape-shares-sink-52-week-121442949.html).

findings.finding: On 2026-10-08 QuantumScape launched the QS PowerBlock, an in-rack AI data-center battery reference design (claimed 4x power density and 5x runtime vs the OCP spec, stable above 300C), shown with Megmeet at the OCP Summit on Oct 12-15. No customer, shipment date or revenue was given, and the stock fell from $4.58 to $3.93 over the next four sessions. The Q3 call is the first chance to report customer engagement after the launch.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The data-center narrative drove the Q1 2026 print's +32% open (Yahoo bars: 2026-04-22 close 7.31, 2026-04-23 open 9.66), which faded to +1.4% at the close. The stock buys this story intraday and sells it by the close.
findings.why_not_priced: The launch was public and sold (-14% in four sessions), so any named customer or ODM design-in on the call would be new. If one were expected, the stock would not have made new lows after the launch.
findings.independence: Axios 2026-10-08: talks with potential customers are underway, none named (https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/quantumscape-makes-move-data-centers-151357823.html). It covers the same launch, so not independent on the product, only on the customer status.

findings.finding: The Q2 letter committed to 'further double cell output in the second half of 2026' on the Eagle Line (core tool uptime above 90%) and said customer sample shipments would 'accelerate significantly across all three verticals' (EV, data center, defense, where QSE-5 cells already shipped to a US defense prime). Q3 is the first scorecard against that commitment.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Operational milestones have not paid. The Eagle Line inauguration (Feb 2026) came before a -11.96% Q4 2025 print.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced, since it is inside the company's own stated goals. Any slip or beat against 'double output' is unknown until the letter.
findings.independence: Q2 call summary repeats the H2 doubling target (https://finance.yahoo.com/m/27afc2ea-1ad8-35ee-8952-e2aae63de480/quantumscape-corporation-q2.html). It reports the same company statement.

findings.finding: CTO Timothy Holme sold 75,000 direct shares plus 45,000 through trusts on 2026-10-05 at a $4.54 weighted average, after 75,000 on 2026-09-15 at $5.09. Both sales ran under a Rule 10b5-1 plan adopted 2026-06-10, so they were pre-scheduled, and he still holds 1.52M Class A plus about 9.5M Class B.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None measured. Finviz reports insider transactions at -0.88%.
findings.why_not_priced: It is public and small relative to his holdings. It reads as a weak signal only because the plan was adopted before the Q2 PowerCo amendment was disclosed.
findings.independence: Finviz insider table lists the same sales (https://finviz.com/quote.ashx?t=QS). It is the same filing, so not independent.

findings.finding: Short interest is 22.3% of float with a 6.7-day short ratio (Finviz), while front-expiry options pay for upside (25d skew -21.6 vol points, put/call OI 0.32) and the stock sits 3% off its 52-week low after -18% in 20 days. Any positive surprise on partners or customers has a squeeze mechanism behind it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q1 2026 print opened +32% on 113M shares (about 9x average volume) then closed +1.4%. Squeeze fuel produced an opening excursion but not a close-to-close move.
findings.why_not_priced: It is partly priced: the call skew is already the market's statement of upside. What the skew does not price is the close-to-close follow-through on a crowded short, and the last two large moves on this name were down.
findings.independence: Sweep row cites Fintel at about 19% of float and 11.44 days to cover (https://fintel.io/ss/us/qs). The sealed baseline skew is an independent options source.

findings.finding: Q2 2026 EPS was -$0.16 on a $98.2M GAAP net loss and about 617M weighted shares, beating -$0.18. With opex flat and capex cut, a similar Q3 loss gives about -$0.16 against a -$0.17/-$0.18 consensus, roughly a 6% beat on the bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q2 EPS beat came with -12.86%. Zacks counts 2 beats, 1 match and 1 miss over four quarters. EPS does not move this name.
findings.why_not_priced: It is largely priced, being a mechanical extrapolation. It is filed for print_vs_bar.
